translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

book.name: UQAFIQOO UFAFA
book.title: UQAFIQOO UFAFA Naaru kambiqaaninnainaina Yoohaneena uqafiqoo ufafa.

content: Saradisa maqusanaasara ufa Yisufa Yoohaneenasaa quqoo ufafa maridanoo.

Yisufa miqi qimasee Tiatira amaana maqasaa rakisirana qimamiseenoo quandakinoo Saradisa amaana maqasaa Paatoonara Yoohaneena qimaminau. Yoohanee anee maa ufana akara rumeeqeenana Saradisa amaana maqasaa rakisira Paatoona amaqaa. Anutuna maraquna dinni taikasee dinni ani qaaramarasee maraquna qumaree marifa dinni taikasee dinni ani qaaraqanda fasau qumaree marifa Yisufa inni Saradisa maqusanaasa qimannimidaqa. Qinee innee auqeemarianara iridaqa. Misa unna qimasee inniara kasimariasee qiafaqa qinee inniara kuqimariasee qidaqa.

Innee minara iriseeqa tauti findifuaqa nimuqusa kaqikaaqoo kasimariqoo kaaqa kuqifoora dauni findi fuaqa. Inneeqa Anutuna saika mareemariana Anutufa qafaidanoo mina afusaa sia anoonaikidanoo minara qinee inniara tauti findifi fuaqee qidaqa.

Innee ooqai qini ufa irimaria oosannara naaqoo irisee qini ufara faqa irisee eedoo qimasee mi mau fifanoo inneeqa mandoosana quandaaqa. Innee sia faiqaranakiqari tauti findififaqa qinee ummuari mari fasiqafara foora tautumannimaqasee anireeqa naruanaura.
Inniki Saradisa maqusanaasa akaqausa sia qikairi faisa maridaqa. Innee qikairi siaisa qini faqa nifaranoo. Inni amiqira marirana amana kai eekara qamunna afisunnimaqasaanaqa qini faqa fifaranoo.

Mandainaina fannoo inni maqee maqee rafaaqafimarifaqa mi manda ainainna uriqararausa inni naanna ramasee eekara qamunna afisunnimaqarara qidaqa inni nuqu faqa naaru kaqi marira papiqakinaana sia ateekaanaura kaqi marianifeera qidaqa. Qinee qeeqa qikoona oorisaa faqa mina qangiroo misa noorisaa faqa innee qikairi siaisara qini faiqi namu fee qianaura.
Anutuna maraquna fannoo aiqama maqusa amaana maqaki keeqee mariasa qimannimidanoo naaqoo faqaasa mi ufana iriaqa.
Firadeerafia maqusanaasara ufa Yisufa Yoohaneenasaa quqoo ufafa maridanoo.

Yisufa miqi qimasee Saradisa amaana maqa Paatoona qimamiseenoo quandaki Firadeerafia amaana maqasaa rakisimarunara Yoohaneena qimaminoo qinau. Yoohanee anee maa ufana akara rumeeqeenana Firadeerafia amaana maqasaa rakisira Paatoona maaqi qimasee amaqaa. Ooqai Dafidifa kooqi kiqa uaqeeuna qinee Yisusa maqee mina uaqeeidaqa ani qimamidaqa. Qinee naaquqara andeeqarausa kuqaa anoona oosana oosana mareemarunausa maa ufana inni qimannimidaqa. Qinee kiqannai kooqi ititasaana sia amana moo fannoo atuarana amana maridanoo, kaifaa qinee kooqi atuasaananoo moo fannoo sia amana ititaannoo.

Innee Firadeerafia maqusanaasara qinee inni aiqamausara amiqimasee iridaqa. Inni noorinni kooqi atuarana quqasaananoo moo fannoo sia amana mina ititaannoo. Inni afeeka kaqikaafa maridanoo innee qini naakapara ufamau fimariasa mariafanoo. Innee maqee maqee qiniara kai iridaqa mariasa mariafanoo.

Iriaqa, Sadanna faiqi namu akaqausa mariasa náriara unna qimasee Yuda maqannaa fee qimasee qimariasa qinee misa mareeqee inni niramandunnai quqasaanaura. Aiqamausa mina qafeeqa oo Yisufa inniara amuqusifanoo miqidanoo fee qiaqeera.

Qinee inniara reendeenamandee mariaqee qiafanaqa innee miqi mariasa mariafanoo. Miqi mariana akiaqara firaa teeroo maaqanna maaqanna nimanamasee qafaanaura miqianna aukuanna qinee inni mareeqee kaqi atinnai quqasaana asumu marifaranoo.
Qinee qusasaa qumuanaura. Innee uriqaraqa mariana amiqimmandee rakisi qumaraaqa moo fannoo qumaraandoora.

Maa maqanasaa mandainaina qambaanai uriqararana qinee mina qumareeqee qeeqa qikoona amaana maqaki quqasaananoo mifa faakanaikinoo mariannoo. Qinee mina afaaqasaa qeeqa qikoona Anutuna auqu quqaanaura, qeeqa Anutuna firaa maqusa fuka Yeerusaree auqu faqa mina afaaqai quqaanaura. Mi maqusafa innaarunaindari qini Anutufinnainadari kasooqaqee qumuannoo. Qinee qeeqa fuka duqu faqa mi fasiqana afaaqai quqaanaura.
Anutuna maraquna fannoo aiqama maqusa amaana maqaki keeqee mariasa qimannimidanoo. Naaqoo faqaasa mi ufana iriaqa.
Raoodiseea maqusanaasara ufa Yisufa Yoohaneenasaa quqoo ufafa maridanoo.

Yisufa miqi qimasee Firadeerafia amaana maqasaa Paatoonara Yoohaneena qimamiseenoo quandaki Raoodiseea amaana maqasaa rakisiranara qimaminoo qinau. Yoohanee anee Raoodiseea amaana maqa rakisira Paatoora faqa maaqi qimasee akara rumamia. Qinee mapukusee marunna fasiqausa Yisusa inni qimannimidaqa. Qinee naaru naaru kuqaa anoona ainaina kai qimarunausa inni qimannimidaqa. Anutufa aiqama ainaina auqimaruna oosana qinee marunausa inni qimannimidaqa.
Qinee innee auqee maru ainainnara iridaqa. Innee sia suaru qiqa mariafanoo innee sia idaidiqa mariafanoo Inni oosana amiqirafa marinaqau kaifaa minara faqa irini.
Inni oosana suanisaa nammariara foora naunanoo ididi marifaqa fididaqa.

Innee unna qimasee inneeqara aiqama ainaina oosana oosana faqaasee qimariafanoo. Inni nifaaqa rumbanoo marifaqa mandaikidaqa kudoosaapaqa maridaqa innee sia minara irimariafanoo. Innee kudi mariafanoo nifu qimbarausara foora mariafanoo kaqisamuara foora mariafanoo.

Qinee maaqi qimasee inni naamua qidaqa, innee qini koora munnimmara foora feefaurumaseeqa minannai naundurakinaa qumiasana moomoo maraaqa. Innee qinisaaqaraa andeeqarana feefaurumasee eekara qamunnara foora marasee inneeqa nisaurirana manda nifaaqasaa afisuaqa. Inneeqa nifu marasinna minniseeqa qini marasinnara foora feefaurumasee inneeqa nifusanara foora narimarinaki akusaifanoo inni nifu amiqiani.
Qinee nimuqusi maria fasiqa anaaseera kai mandainainaki keeqaafaqa qaoo qimasee naridaqa. Innee minara irisee kuqaa noori runusee inneeqa marirana quandaaqa.

Iriaqa qinee Yisusa faiqí nimuqusa kooqi afaisaa kikiqammambiqa kooqi atuaannee qimasee kukusidaqa. Faiqí moo fannoo qinee kukusiannana irinoo narí kooqi atuqainaqa qinee mina amuqusa ooki keeqafiqa mina faqa naanaura mifa qini faqa naannoo.

Qinee maa maqanasaa mandainainakiqari uriqararausa maridaqa qeeqa qikoosandiri narí rakisira qaarisaa ooqufaaqee idaqa. Maa maqanasaa mandainainakiqari rakirara foora uriqarainafa mifa miqi kai inoo qinee rakisira qaarisaa innaaruna ququsaki qini faqa ooqufaaqee mariannoo.
Anutuna maraquna fannoo aiqama maqusa amaana maqaki keeqee mariasa qimannimidanoo. Naaqoo faqaasa mi ufana iriaqa.
